ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at 0.05:1 across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation field across both lobes; punctuated by scattered, discrete, high-contrast white circular spots of varying diameters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, varying amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave curves from the median notch extending into sharp convex arcs toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed semi-randomly across both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent irregular indentation on the superior edge of the left lobe; multiple punctate white scars on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pointed, vertically-oriented distal lobe tips exhibiting a sharp, hook-like appearance.
